     6	class TypeBuilder(NodeVisitor):
     7	    """
     8	    A class that converts an Eywa type to a C type.
     9	    """
    10	
    11	    @staticmethod
    12	    def build(type: Type) -> str:
    13	        """
    14	        Convert an Eywa type to a C type as a string.
    15	        """
    16	        return TypeBuilder().visit(type)
    17	
    18	    def visit_Void(self, node):
    19	        return "void", ""
    20	
    21	    def visit_Bool(self, node):
    22	        return "bool", ""
    23	
    24	    def visit_Char(self, node):
    25	        return "char", ""
    26	
    27	    def visit_Int(self, node):
    28	        if node.size == 64:
    29	            return "uint64_t", ""
    30	        if node.size == 32:
    31	            return "uint32_t", ""
    32	        if node.size == 16:
    33	            return "uint16_t", ""
    34	        if node.size == 8:
    35	            return "uint8_t", ""
    36	        return "int", f": {node.size}"
    37	
    38	    def visit_String(self, node):
    39	        return "char*", ""
    40	
    41	    def visit_Enum(self, node):
    42	        return node.name, ""
    43	
    44	    def visit_Array(self, node):
    45	        (left, right) = self.visit(node.element_type)
    46	        return left, f"{right}[{node.maxsize}]"
    47	
    48	    def visit_Struct(self, node):
    49	        return node.name, ""
    50	
    51	    def visit_Alias(self, node):
    52	        return node.name, ""

    55	class DefinitionBuilder(NodeVisitor):
    56	    """
    57	    A class that creates a C type definition (if needed) for
    58	    a given Eywa type. This includes enums, structs, and aliases.
    59	    """
    60	
    61	    @staticmethod
    62	    def build(type: Type) -> str:
    63	        """
    64	        Build a C type definition for an Eywa type if necessary.
    65	        """
    66	        return DefinitionBuilder().visit(type)
    67	
    68	    def visit_Void(self, node):
    69	        return None
    70	
    71	    def visit_Bool(self, node):
    72	        return None
    73	
    74	    def visit_Char(self, node):
    75	        return None
    76	
    77	    def visit_Int(self, node):
    78	        return None
    79	
    80	    def visit_String(self, node):
    81	        return None
    82	
    83	    def visit_Enum(self, node):
    84	        return f'typedef enum {{ {", ".join(node.values)} }} {node.name};\n'
    85	
    86	    def visit_Array(self, node):
    87	        return None
    88	
    89	    def visit_Struct(self, node):
    90	        field_strs = []
    91	        # print(node.fields.items())
    92	        
    93	        for (field_name, field) in node.fields.items():
    94	            # print("Field:", field_name, field)
    95	            (left, right) = TypeBuilder.build(field)
    96	            field_strs.append(f"{left} {field_name}{right};")
    97	            # print("Bye")
    98	        fields = " ".join(field_strs)
    99	        return f'typedef struct {{ {fields} }} {node.name};\n'
   100	
   101	    def visit_Alias(self, node):
   102	        (left, right) = TypeBuilder.build(node.type)
   103	        description = "" if node.description is None else '\n'.join(
   104	            [f'// {line}' for line in node.description.splitlines()]) + '\n'
   105	        return f'{description}typedef {left} {node.name}{right};\n'

   108	class TypeCollector(NodeVisitor):
   109	    """
   110	    A class to recursively extract all of the Ewya sub-types in a type.
   111	    """
   112	
   113	    @staticmethod
   114	    def collect(type: Type, results: List[Type]):
   115	        """
   116	        Collect all the Eywa types in a given type.
   117	        """
   118	        TypeCollector(results).visit(type)

   121	        self.result = result
   122	
   123	    def visit_Void(self, node):
   124	        self.result.append(node)
   125	
   126	    def visit_Bool(self, node):
   127	        self.result.append(node)
   128	
   129	    def visit_Char(self, node):
   130	        self.result.append(node)
   131	
   132	    def visit_Int(self, node):
   133	        self.result.append(node)
   134	
   135	    def visit_String(self, node):
   136	        self.result.append(node)
   137	
   138	    def visit_Enum(self, node):
   139	        self.result.append(node)
   140	
   141	    def visit_Array(self, node):
   142	        self.visit(node.element_type)
   143	        self.result.append(node)
   144	
   145	    def visit_Struct(self, node):
   146	        for (_, field) in node.fields.items():
   147	            self.visit(field)
   148	        self.result.append(node)

   155	class MainBuilder(NodeVisitor):
   156	    """
   157	    A class to build the KLEE main function that creates the symbolic
   158	    inputs and runs the implementation given by the GPT model.
   159	    """
   160	
   161	    def __init__(self, result):
   162	        self.result = result
   163	        self.number = 0
   164	
   165	    def _next(self):
   166	        n = self.number
   167	        self.number = self.number + 1
   168	        return f'x{n}'
   169	
   170	    def _is_array(self, node):
   171	        while isinstance(node, Alias):
   172	            node = node.type
   173	        return isinstance(node, Array)
   174	
   175	    def visit_Void(self, node):
   176	        raise Exception('Cannot create an instance of the Void type')
   177	
   178	    def visit_Bool(self, node):
   179	        var = self._next()
   180	        self.result.append(f'bool {var};')
   181	        self.result.append(
   182	            f'klee_make_symbolic(&{var}, sizeof({var}), "{var}");')
   183	        return var
   184	
   185	    def visit_Char(self, node):
   186	        var = self._next()
   187	        self.result.append(f'char {var};')
   188	        self.result.append(
   189	            f'klee_make_symbolic(&{var}, sizeof({var}), "{var}");')
   190	        return var
   191	
   192	    def visit_Int(self, node):
   193	        var = self._next()
   194	        self.result.append(f'{TypeBuilder.build(node)[0]} {var};')
   195	        self.result.append(
   196	            f'klee_make_symbolic(&{var}, sizeof({var}), "{var}");')
   197	        return var
   198	
   199	    def visit_String(self, node):
   200	        var1 = self._next()
   201	        self.result.append(f'char {var1}[{node.maxsize + 1}];')
   202	        for i in range(0, node.maxsize):
   203	            cvar = self.visit(node.char_type)
   204	            # assign the char to the array.
   205	            self.result.append(f'{var1}[{i}] = {cvar};')
   206	        self.result.append(f"{var1}[{node.maxsize}] = '\\0';")
   207	        return var1
   208	
   209	    def visit_Enum(self, node):
   210	        var = self._next()
   211	        self.result.append(f'{node.name} {var};')
   212	        self.result.append(
   213	            f'klee_make_symbolic(&{var}, sizeof({var}), "{var}");')
   214	        self.result.append(f'klee_assume({var} >= 0);')
   215	        self.result.append(f'klee_assume({var} < {len(node.values)});')
   216	        return var
   217	
   218	    def visit_Array(self, node):
   219	        var = self._next()
   220	        (l, r) = TypeBuilder.build(node.element_type)
   221	        self.result.append(f'{l} {var}{r}[{node.maxsize}];')
   222	        for i in range(0, node.maxsize):
   223	            evar = self.visit(node.element_type)
   224	            self.result.append(f'{var}[{i}] = {evar};')
   225	        return var
   226	
   227	    def visit_Struct(self, node):
   228	        var = self._next()
   229	        self.result.append(f'{node.name} {var};')
   230	        for (field_name, field) in node.fields.items():
   231	            field_var = self.visit(field)
   232	            if self._is_array(field):
   233	                self.result.append(
   234	                    f'memcpy({var}.{field_name}, {field_var}, sizeof({field_var}));')
   235	            else:
   236	                self.result.append(f'{var}.{field_name} = {field_var};')
   237	        return var
   238	
   239	    def visit_Alias(self, node):
   240	        return self.visit(node.type)

   242	class ResultReader(NodeVisitor):
   243	    """
   244	    Class to read the results of a KLEE run and convert them to Python values.
   245	    """
   246	
   247	    def __init__(self, assignment: Dict[str, int]):
   248	        self.number = 0
   249	        self.assignment = assignment
   250	        self.mx = 0
   251	        for key in assignment:
   252	            self.mx = max(int(key[-1]), self.mx)
   253	        
   254	    def _lookup(self):
   255	        n = self._next()
   256	        while n not in self.assignment:
   257	            n = self._next()
   258	            if int(n[-1]) > self.mx:
   259	                break
   260	        if n in self.assignment:
   261	            return self.assignment[n]
   262	        raise Exception("Invalid assignment")
   263	
   264	    def _next(self):
   265	        n = self.number
   266	        self.number = self.number + 1
   267	        return f'x{n}'
   268	
   269	    def visit_Void(self, node):
   270	        raise Exception('Cannot create an instance of the Void type')
   271	
   272	    def visit_Bool(self, node):
   273	        return bool(self._lookup())
   274	
   275	    def visit_Char(self, node):
   276	        return chr(self._lookup())
   277	
   278	    def visit_Int(self, node):
   279	        return int(self._lookup())
   280	
   281	    def visit_String(self, node):
   282	        self._next()  # char[] variable
   283	        str = ""
   284	        done = False
   285	        for _ in range(0, node.maxsize):
   286	            c = self.visit(node.char_type)
   287	            if c == '\0':
   288	                done = True
   289	            if not done:
   290	                str = str + c
   291	        return str
   292	
   293	    def visit_Enum(self, node):
   294	        return node.values[self._lookup()]
   295	
   296	    def visit_Array(self, node):
   297	        self._next()  # array variable
   298	        result = []
   299	        for _ in range(0, node.maxsize):
   300	            result.append(self.visit(node.element_type))
   301	        return tuple(result)
   302	
   303	    def visit_Struct(self, node):
   304	        self._next()  # struct variable
   305	        result = {}
   306	        for (field_name, field) in node.fields.items():
   307	            result[field_name] = self.visit(field)
   308	        return result
   309	
   310	    def visit_Alias(self, node):
   311	        return self.visit(node.type)

   314	class RegexModule(Function):
   315	    """_summary_
   316	    A module that checks for regex matches.
   317	    """
   318	    def __init__(self, name: str, regex_str: str, input: Parameter):
   319	        self.name = name
   320	        self.inputs = [input]
   321	        self.regex_str = regex_str
   322	        self.precondition = None
   323	        self.description = f'Module that checks if the input matches the regex: {regex_str}'
   324	        self.regex = self.get_regex()
   325	        self.result = Parameter(name="result", type=Bool(), description="True if the input matches the regex, False otherwise")
   326	        
   327	    @staticmethod
   328	    def regex_parser(regex: str) -> re.Regex:
   329	        if regex == "":
   330	            return re.Empty()
   331	        
   332	        stack = []
   333	        i = 0
   334	        # print("Parsing regex:", regex)
   335	        while i < len(regex):
   336	            char = regex[i]
   337	            
   338	            if char == '*':
   339	                r = stack.pop()
   340	                stack.append(re.star(r))
   341	            
   342	            elif char == '(':
   343	                j = i + 1
   344	                paren_count = 1
   345	                while j < len(regex) and paren_count > 0:
   346	                    if regex[j] == '(':
   347	                        paren_count += 1
   348	                    elif regex[j] == ')':
   349	                        paren_count -= 1
   350	                    j += 1
   351	                sub_regex = regex[i + 1:j - 1]
   352	                stack.append(RegexModule.regex_parser(sub_regex))
   353	                i = j - 1
   354	            
   355	            elif char == '[':
   356	                j = i + 1
   357	                options = []
   358	                while j < len(regex) and regex[j] != ']':
   359	                    if j + 1 < len(regex) and regex[j + 1] == '-':
   360	                        low = regex[j]
   361	                        if regex[j+2] == '\\':
   362	                            high = regex[j + 3]
   363	                            j += 3
   364	                        else:
   365	                            high = regex[j + 2]
   366	                            j += 2
   367	                        options.append(re.chars(low, high))
   368	                        
   369	                    elif regex[j] == '\\':
   370	                        low = regex[j + 1]
   371	                        high = regex[j + 1]
   372	                        j += 1
   373	                        options.append(re.chars(low, high))
   374	                        
   375	                    else:
   376	                        low = regex[j]
   377	                        high = regex[j]
   378	                        options.append(re.chars(low, high))
   379	                    j += 1
   380	                    
   381	                if len(options) == 1:
   382	                    stack.append(options[0])
   383	                elif len(options) > 1:
   384	                    stack.append(re.choice(*options))
   385	                i = j
   386	                
   387	            elif char == '|':
   388	                r1 = stack.pop()
   389	                sub_regex = regex[i+1:]
   390	                r2 = RegexModule.regex_parser(sub_regex)
   391	                stack.append(re.choice(r1, r2))
   392	                break
   393	                
   394	            else:
   395	                if char == '\\':
   396	                    i += 1
   397	                char = regex[i]
   398	                stack.append(re.chars(char, char))
   399	                
   400	            
   401	            i += 1   
   402	        
   403	        return re.seq(*stack) if len(stack) > 1 else stack[0]
   404	    
   405	    def get_regex(self) -> re.Regex:
   406	        regex = self.regex_str
   407	        return self.regex_parser(regex)
